exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 Booking Opera Tickets
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Clerk: Good afternoon, City Theatre box office. How can I help you?
Tom: Hi, I'd like to book two tickets for the Peking Opera on Saturday evening.
Clerk: Of course. Saturday's show starts at seven o'clock. The seats near the front are forty pounds each.
Tom: That's a bit too expensive for us. Do you have anything cheaper?
Clerk: We have seats at the back for twenty pounds. You can still see the stage clearly.
Tom: Great, I'll take two of those, please.
Clerk: No problem. Please arrive ten minutes early, because the doors close once the show begins.
Tom: Thank you. We're really looking forward to it.
exercises.translation_cn: Tom 打电话到城市剧院售票处,想订周六晚上京剧的两张票;周六演出7点开始,前排每张40英镑,太贵;售票员推荐后排每张20英镑、仍能看清舞台;Tom 订了两张后排票;售票员提醒提前十分钟到,因为开演后就关门;Tom 表示很期待。

exercises.title: U4 听力·独白 My First Ballet Lesson
exercises.speaker: uk_female
exercises.transcript: Last month I went to my very first ballet lesson, and I was extremely nervous. I had always loved watching dancers move so gracefully on stage, but I had never tried it myself. At the beginning, even standing correctly felt difficult, and my legs ached after only ten minutes. My teacher was kind and patient. She told me that every great dancer was once a beginner, and that hard work matters far more than talent. Little by little, I began to enjoy each movement. Now I practise at home every evening, and I dream of dancing in a real performance one day.
exercises.translation_cn: 上个月我第一次上芭蕾课,非常紧张。我一直喜欢看舞者在台上优雅起舞,却从没自己试过。一开始连站姿都很难,十分钟后腿就酸了。老师友善又耐心,告诉我每位伟大舞者都曾是初学者,努力比天赋更重要。渐渐地我开始享受每个动作。如今我每晚在家练习,梦想有朝一日能在真正的演出中起舞。

options: Even standing in the correct way.

options: Hard work rather than natural talent.

options: To dance in a real performance one day.

exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 What Shall We Watch Tonight?
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Mum: There's nothing good on TV tonight. What would you like to watch, Lily?
Lily: How about that new talent show? Everyone at school is talking about it.
Mum: I'm not really a fan of talent shows. The judges talk too much.
Lily: Then what about a nature documentary? There's one about leopards at eight.
Mum: That sounds lovely. I do enjoy learning about wild animals.
Lily: Great. We can watch the talent show later online if you don't mind.
Mum: That's fine. Let's make some popcorn before the documentary starts.
Lily: Perfect. I'll get the bowls.
exercises.translation_cn: 妈妈说今晚电视没什么好看,问 Lily 想看什么;Lily 提议看大家都在聊的新选秀节目;妈妈不太喜欢选秀,觉得评委话太多;Lily 改提议八点的豹子纪录片;妈妈说喜欢了解野生动物,欣然同意;Lily 说选秀可以晚点在网上看;妈妈提议开演前做点爆米花;Lily 去拿碗。

exercises.title: U4 听力·独白 Comedy Club Advertisement
exercises.speaker: uk_male
exercises.transcript: Are you looking for a fun way to spend your weekend? Come to the Riverside Comedy Club, the brightest place in town for a good laugh. Every Friday and Saturday night, our stage welcomes some of the funniest performers in the country. Doors open at half past seven, and the show begins at eight. Tickets cost just fifteen pounds, and students pay only ten. Seats fill up quickly, so we strongly advise you to book early online. Bring your friends, leave your worries at home, and get ready for an evening full of jokes and laughter. We promise you will not be disappointed.
exercises.translation_cn: 想找个有趣的方式过周末吗?来河畔喜剧俱乐部——城里最欢乐的地方。每周五、周六晚,我们的舞台迎来全国最搞笑的表演者。七点半开门,八点开演。门票仅15英镑,学生只需10英镑。座位很快售罄,强烈建议提前网上订票。带上朋友,把烦恼留在家里,准备好享受充满笑声的夜晚。我们保证你不会失望。

exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 Travelling to a Concert
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Anna: I've got two tickets for the concert in Manchester next Saturday. Do you want to come?
Ben: I'd love to! But Manchester is quite far. How are we going to get there?
Anna: I've already made all the arrangements. We'll take the morning train from London.
Ben: Good idea. Trains are faster than coaches. What time does it leave?
Anna: At nine, so we should meet at the station by half past eight.
Ben: Where are we staying for the night?
Anna: I've booked a small hotel near the concert hall, so we can walk there easily.
Ben: You've thought of everything. I can't wait!
exercises.translation_cn: Anna 有两张下周六曼彻斯特演唱会的票,邀请 Ben 同去;Ben 很想去,但担心曼彻斯特远,怎么去;Anna 说已安排好,坐早上从伦敦出发的火车;Ben 赞同,火车比长途车快,问几点出发;Anna 说九点,所以八点半在车站碰头;Ben 问晚上住哪;Anna 已在音乐厅附近订了小旅馆,步行即到;Ben 称赞她想得周到,十分期待。

exercises.title: U4 听力·独白 A Film I Saw Last Night
exercises.speaker: uk_male
exercises.transcript: Last night I watched a film that was based on a famous novel I had read at school. I went in expecting to be disappointed, because films often leave out my favourite parts of a story. To my surprise, this one was different. The director kept the main plot and most of the important characters, and the acting was wonderful. Of course, a few scenes were missing, but the film still captured the spirit of the book. By the end, I was deeply moved, and several people in the cinema were quietly clapping. I would definitely recommend it, whether or not you have read the original story.
exercises.translation_cn: 昨晚我看了一部根据我上学时读过的著名小说改编的电影。本以为会失望,因为电影常删掉我最喜欢的情节。出乎意料,这部不同:导演保留了主线和大多数重要角色,表演也很棒。当然有几场戏被删了,但电影仍抓住了原著的精神。看到最后我深受感动,影院里有几个人在轻轻鼓掌。无论你是否读过原著,我都强烈推荐。
